title: msn-lib-op/1: what msn lib add or build did to a library
description: The result of `mzlab-cli msn lib add|build`: the library file, the ids, its size and, for add, whether the entry was new. With --dry-run nothing is written (dry_run true; add carries would_write). Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/msn_lib.rs.
